collection.description: A parent wants immediate forgiveness after unfairly scolding a child.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (parent) wants immediate forgiveness after unfairly scolding (child).

choices.label: Apologize and Allow the Child Time
Ask What Would Help Repair the Hurt
Avoid Asking the Child to Comfort the Parent

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) accepts the apology later that evening.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) needs several days before feeling ready to talk.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) asks to be listened to before being corrected.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) cannot yet say what would help, and (parent) waits.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (parent) slips once, recognizes it, and apologizes again.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (parent) learns to manage their own disappointment privately.

d1__fx.name: Outcome D1
d1__fx.text: (child) feels relieved that forgiveness is not demanded.

d1__text.text: (child) feels relieved that forgiveness is not demanded.
